name: GANeRF
definition: A method that optimizes a 3D radiance field representation using a 2D adversarial loss, where a discriminator learns the distribution of image patches and provides gradient feedback to the NeRF to enforce 3D-consistent photorealism.
summary: GANeRF optimizes 3D radiance fields using a 2D adversarial loss to enforce 3D-consistent photorealism, distinguishing itself by directly backpropagating from a discriminator to a full-resolution NeRF.
